data_handling: Every numeric group inherits published date, period, audit status and URL from source_id. USD/RMB/HKD billion unless stated. Source hash establishes consistency only. Raw originals excluded from Git. Company run rate, ACV and ARR are not audited full-year GAAP revenue.
market_data: Current prices, market caps, FX and harmonized valuation denominators are owned by the parent market-data lane. No dated private round is a current quoted public EV.

model_capital_status.name: OpenAI
model_capital_status.status: Nonlisted public-market exposure only indirect in retrieved primary evidence; do not treat IPO discussion as completed
model_capital_status.judgment: Financing commitments and cloud partners support funding access, but no complete audited cash-burn/obligation bridge; equity terms and actual funded cash remain essential.

model_capital_status.name: Anthropic
model_capital_status.status: Confidential S1 announced; proposed IPO is not a completed listing
model_capital_status.judgment: Do not add prior commitments twice; large capacity agreements are obligations/availability rather than proof of utilized paid demand.

model_capital_status.name: xAI / SpaceX
model_capital_status.status: xAI acquired 2026-02-02; SpaceX IPO pricing 2026-06-11, SPCX trading expected 2026-06-12; mixed space/connectivity/AI public exposure
model_capital_status.judgment: A SpaceX market multiple cannot be assigned wholly to xAI. Standalone xAI operating profitability, intercompany allocations and minority rights require segment-level evidence.

model_capital_status.name: MiniMax
model_capital_status.status: Hong Kong listed 00100; IPO Jan9 2026, dual-class and commercialization-stage flags apply
model_capital_status.judgment: Revenue +283.1% does not close the profitability gap; broad treasury is not unrestricted cash, adjusted loss is not cash burn. API/enterprise share 63.4% changes mix; token volume is not realized net price.

model_capital_status.name: Z.AI / 智谱
model_capital_status.status: Hong Kong listed 02513; future A-share IPO discussions are not an existing A-share security
model_capital_status.judgment: API mix rose as local deployment shrank: GP margin roughly26.4%, adjusted loss widened despite lower headline net loss. Cash financing buys capacity; 2027 USD settlement creates refinancing/FX or dilution risk, rather than free zero-interest capital.

model_capital_status.name: DeepSeek
model_capital_status.status: No verified listed security or current completed financing terms established in retrieved original sources
model_capital_status.judgment: Do not repeat 2025 claims of no outside funding. Conflicting 2026 aggregator/media figures are not admitted; current financing, recognized revenue, cash burn and ownership are unresolved.

model_capital_status.name: Databricks
model_capital_status.status: Private in retrieved evidence, current completed round announced Aug13
model_capital_status.judgment: Data/governance/routing can capture spend across models; positive adjusted TTM FCF is an issuer claim without a public full cash bridge. Run-rate and private equity valuation cannot be compared with public EV/GAAP sales without adjustment.

hyperscalers.name: Microsoft
hyperscalers.earnings_quality: Company non-GAAP adjusts OpenAI, but $3.2bn Anthropic gain remains. FY27 building useful lives15->25 years and finance-to-operating lease reclassification change accounting presentation; economic investment stated unchanged. RPO growth84% vs25% excluding OpenAI indicates concentration.

hyperscalers.name: Alphabet
hyperscalers.earnings_quality: Mark-to-market gains dominate net profit; normalize before P/E. Equity/preferred financing, capital commitments and ordinary-share claims must enter capitalization. $40bn ATM authorization had no sales atJun30; authorization is not cash. Other-income gains are pretax: do not subtract97.983 directly from after-tax112.193; use the specific tax bridge. Cloud segment OP excludes shared Alphabet-level AI R&D and other costs;8.814bn is not independent standalone AI profit. Ordinary equity uses112.107bn after86m preferred dividend, not consolidated112.193bn.

hyperscalers.name: Amazon
hyperscalers.actual_period: Q2 ended2026-06-30 with TTM cash flow
hyperscalers.earnings_quality: AI and chips run rates overlap and are not separate GAAP segments; Anthropic revaluation cannot fund cash Capex. $220bn CY2026 capex guidance was not tied to an original call in this lane; omitted from verified guide table.

hyperscalers.name: Meta
hyperscalers.earnings_quality: GAAP margin20% includes litigation; charge-adjusted arithmetic35.4% still needs other normalization. AI-driven advertising attribution is management interpretation; all capex is not standalone AI investment.

hyperscalers.name: Alibaba
hyperscalers.earnings_quality: Segments redefined with recast comparison; do not mix old Cloud Intelligence. Cloud profit coexists with model/apps loss, intersegment eliminations prevent double counting; Aug26 equity funding changes ordinary-share denominator.

hyperscalers.name: Tencent
hyperscalers.earnings_quality: Q2 CFO is52.7bn;154.061bn is H1 and cannot substitute. Excluding prepayments explains timing but does not undo the cash payment or establish return; ad/app AI has no separate audited P&L.

hyperscalers.name: Baidu
hyperscalers.earnings_quality: AI business+25% coexists with GeneralBusiness−4% and legacy−23%; AI categories are management taxonomy, not all incremental revenue. Robotaxi permits/cities/autonomouskm are not paid-trip cash returns.

applications.name: Palantir
applications.judgment: Strong actual growth/operating profitability supports distribution/ontology/workflow monetization. Total revenue is not AI-only; SBC and government/project concentration remain relevant; valuation must survive slowing growth.

applications.name: ServiceNow
applications.judgment: Workflow access and governance are potential moat; AI ACV does not prove realized margin. GAAP4% and adjusted29.5% OP margins differ materially; acquisition growth and recurring SBC need bridge. Oct28Q3 is future at cutoff.

applications.name: Salesforce
applications.judgment: Growth11% contains roughly4pointsInformatica. Expanded AI ARR is not a clean like-for-like adoption series; buybacks and investment gains can lift EPS while ordinary operating growth is weaker.

applications.name: Adobe
applications.judgment: AI features can strengthen format/workflow distribution but model-native creation threatens seats and pricing. Need net paid retention and incremental ARPU, not product MAU or ARR percentage without base.

applications.name: 金山办公
applications.earnings_quality: 扣非 profit still contains large fund-related investment income; company adjusted profit removes SBC, fund investment gains and related tax, so it is not an automatically accepted owner-earnings figure. Management says investment-gain prepaid income tax depressed cash flow; actual cash remains paid. WPS365 is an AI/collaboration bundle, not pure incremental AI revenue.
applications.judgment: Existing workflow and paid subscriptions support a distribution moat; quantify net AI upsell and inference cost before attributing bundle growth to AI. Use normalized core earnings rather than the headline237% net-profit growth.

applications.name: 科大讯飞
applications.judgment: Headline9M profit turns positive while扣非 remains negative and CFO barely covers a fraction of cash long-term investment. Funded liquidity is distinct from end-user profitability; education/medical/model/consumer mix, government receivables and capitalized development require further bridge. No all-company revenue equals standalone model sales assertion.

layer_economics.rent_now: Product scarcity, brand, coding/enterprise distribution and model-specific task success can support premium pricing; public loss data show revenue growth alone has not proven durable excess returns.
layer_economics.valuation: Bridge ordinary equity to existing debt, preferred, lease and CB claims; separately model compute-prepayment assets/customer prepayment obligations, committed fulfillment costs and future funding/dilution scenarios. Undrawn capacity and all prepayments are not automatically current EV debt. Avoid charging the same future cost in both EV bridge and DCF. Sustainable gross profit/cohort contribution and cash runway precede EV/sales; private postmoney is not EV.
layer_economics.strongest_counter: Better models, inference optimization and enterprise contracts could make contribution improve faster than price erosion; today’s training burn may seed scale economics.
layer_economics.falsifier: Realized net price falls faster than cost per accepted task while external paid revenue/retention fail to compensate; capital requirement outgrows funded unrestricted resources.

layer_economics.layer: Data, middleware, inference optimization, evaluation and security
layer_economics.rent_now: Data access, lineage, policy, observability and cross-model cost routing become scarce when raw inference commoditizes. Generic orchestration can be bundled away.
listed_examples: 688111.SH 金山办公 (mixed applications exposure; financial AI split not verified)
002230.SZ 科大讯飞 (mixed models/devices/software; financial AI split not verified)
layer_economics.valuation: Consumption revenue net of underlying cloud/model pass-through, NRR and GP/FCF, integration and switching costs; avoid counting resold inference twice.
layer_economics.strongest_counter: Cloud/model vendors can bundle tooling, open-source components lower switching costs and usage growth can carry low gross profit.
layer_economics.falsifier: Usage/queries rise without retained net revenue or GP; multi-cloud customer adoption stagnates; acquisition rather than organic expansion explains growth.

layer_economics.rent_now: Installed distribution, permissions, proprietary operational context, action rights and accountable ROI can retain rent. Thin prompt/UI wrappers lack protection.
layer_economics.valuation: Organic ARR/revenue, gross/net retention, seat and ARPU decomposition, accepted-task contribution, normalized OP/FCF after SBC/dilution and implementation support.
layer_economics.strongest_counter: Frontier labs enter the workflow, agents reduce seats and usage pricing transfers productivity savings to buyers.
layer_economics.falsifier: AI ARR grows through scope changes/acquisitions while organic net retention or per-task economics deteriorate; customers do not renew once pilots end.

layer_economics.rent_now: Distribution, recommendation data and ad auctions monetize AI indirectly; cash profits can fund training/app subsidies.
layer_economics.valuation: Incremental ad yield/conversion and user retention versus total inference/acquisition costs; normalize investment gains and legal/tax effects.
layer_economics.strongest_counter: AI substitutes for search/commerce clicks, inference expense rises faster than monetization, and regulation/IP can impair distribution.
layer_economics.falsifier: Engagement grows but paid conversion/revenue per inference and free cash deteriorate after cohort and mix controls.

layer_economics.rent_now: No uniform proof of scaled profitable humanoid demand; robotics platforms must bridge hardware reliability, field labor and regulation.
listed_examples: 300024.SZ 机器人 and002747.SZ 埃斯顿 (industrial automation; not pure humanoid revenue)
layer_economics.valuation: Paid deployments/order acceptance -> intervention minutes/uptime -> all-in cost per productive hour/trip -> warranty, insurance and replacement fleet Capex -> after-financing FCF. Stage gates and SOTP rather than TAM times arbitrary share.
layer_economics.strongest_counter: Foundation-policy improvements and cheap hardware may accelerate adoption rapidly, but demo autonomy and shipped units do not show paid customer ROI.
layer_economics.falsifier: Paid deployments lack verified customer acceptance, collections or renewals; order cancellation rights are unknown or extensive; supervision, useful-life or reliability assumptions fail. Lack of deposits alone does not invalidate an otherwise legitimate enterprise order.

unit_economics.model_formula: Contribution per token = realized net price - variable cost. Gross margin = contribution / realized net price.
unit_economics.application_formula: All-in accepted task cost=(tokens + tools + infrastructure + review + expected failure/remediation cost)/accepted completion probability. Compare against customer incremental value; token price alone is insufficient.
unit_economics.judgment: Lower inference prices can widen app contribution, expand demand and move rent from models to workflows; equally, it can cannibalize API revenue and hardware utilization. Direction depends on demand elasticity, cost reduction, task reliability and financing.

capital_cycle.mechanism: Supplier invests equity/credit in model customer -> customer commits to cloud -> cloud books backlog/receivables -> hyperscaler buys chips/power -> vendors recognize revenue. These are linked cash flows, not independent final demand.
concrete_evidence: OpenAI round lists hyperscalers and compute suppliers; committed capital not all funded cash
Anthropic SeriesH includes prior Amazon/hyperscaler commitments; avoid duplicate financing
Amazon/Alphabet investment markups materially inflate net earnings
Alibaba new AI segments show cloud profit plus app loss with intersegment eliminations
capital_cycle.not_concluded: Cross-investment alone does not prove fake revenue or fraud; require related-party, contract termination, credit, collection and outside-customer demand evidence.
capital_cycle.downside_chain: Paid demand misses -> model losses and down-rounds -> customer financing fails -> compute contract renegotiation/default -> cloud collection/backlog disappointment -> GPU residual collateral falls -> secured funding haircuts -> forced asset sales -> capacity price falls and equity dilution.

research_judgment.direction: Positive on AI usage and selected distribution/workflow monetization; mixed on durable model profits and public-equity returns at current capital claims; no uniform sector buy view.
research_judgment.decision_hinge: How much final external customer cash survives all compute/training, renewal and financing obligations per ordinary diluted share?
research_judgment.where_rent_is_visible: AWS/other cloud operating income, installed software and ad distribution have current reported profit; stand-alone listed model labs show large losses. Neither observation guarantees future rank or investment return.
research_judgment.confidence: High on arithmetic and disclosed transaction identity subject to review scope; medium on causal economic interpretations; low/unproven on future pricing power, model gross margins and investment performance. No numerical win probability assigned.
research_judgment.underwriting_gate: Before a positive ownership conclusion, parent must combine current prices, diluted capital/EV including new financing, normalized earnings and cash economics, then stress price/mix, capacity utilization, hardware lives and funding closure. Research collection is not a completed forecast model.

master_investor_crosscheck.Buffett_Munger_lens: Circle of competence, cash earning power, durable moat, reinvestment returns, management capital allocation and margin of safety: model leaderboard/user counts do not answer owner earnings.
master_investor_crosscheck.Graham_lens: Separate security price from business narrative; prefer balance-sheet survivability and evidenced earning power over financing valuation anchoring.
master_investor_crosscheck.Fisher_lens: Long runway and product strength matter only with customer evidence, sales efficiency and disciplined economics.
master_investor_crosscheck.limitation: Analyst application of principles, not claims that any master has reviewed these firms or endorsed this conclusion.

monitoring.question: Does AI adoption pay for itself?
observations: Net inference price versus variable cost and accepted-task cost
Training R&D, leases, prepayments and cash consumption
monitoring.trigger: If claimed usage/ARR accelerates while like-for-like revenue, GP or cash conversion worsens, reopen pricing/mix/subsidy thesis; do not upgrade automatically.

monitoring.question: Is cloud demand financially independent and collectible?
observations: Customer funding and actual capacity utilization
monitoring.trigger: Backlog rises with collection deterioration or customer financing stress -> discount cash timing and review committed buildout; contractual commitment is not collected revenue.

monitoring.question: Are adjusted metrics hiding cash or dilution?
observations: GAAP to issuer-adjusted to analyst-normalized bridges
Depreciation useful-life and finance/operating lease changes
monitoring.trigger: Any new share or preferred/convertible claim, debt-funded buyback or accounting-life change requires refreshed ordinary-equity/cash bridge before valuation comparison.

monitoring.question: Can frontier/private risks spill over to public suppliers?
observations: Compute prepay refundability and supplier obligations
monitoring.trigger: Funding terms tighten, major counterparty cannot finance commitment, or collateral falls -> scenario loss of utilization/refinancing rather than assume perpetual backlog conversion.

monitoring.question: Are operational agents/robots economically real?
observations: Paid accepted outcomes rather than tool calls/km/demos
Cohort renewals and customer net ROI
monitoring.trigger: Accepted task or productive hour cost fails customer alternative after supervision -> reduce scale/profit assumptions even when benchmark score improves.
